reasoning: For a nonnegative order statistic, expectation equals the integral of its survival probability. Between consecutive interval endpoints each variable is certainly above, certainly below, or has a linear probability of exceeding x. A polynomial Bernoulli-count DP computes the probability that at least K variables exceed x. Integrate every coefficient exactly in the prime field over that interval, including the initial interval from0. No floating-point approximation or Monte Carlo is used.
